//: These settings are easier to change in-game! Mod List -> What Durability? -> Config

Enable What Durability?.//: Whether What Durability? is enabled. When disabled, none of its features run and its other settings are hidden. Takes effect after a restart.

itemsWithDurability.//: Items that keep their durability, separated by a comma. Item tags work too, starting with a '#'. For example: 'minecraft:elytra,#minecraft:trimmable_armor'. When the mod is installed on a server, the list of the server is used.
